summary_en: This phase III trial tests adding gemcitabine to BCG given into the bladder, compared with BCG alone, in people with recurrent high grade non-muscle invasive bladder cancer that came back after prior BCG. Gemcitabine is given into the bladder over 1 hour, on weeks 1, 4, 7 and 10, and BCG is given over 2 hours on weeks 2, 3, 6, 8 and 9, with repeat treatment at months 3, 6 and 12 if there is no disease progression or unacceptable toxicity. The record does not state the main outcome measure; the study is phase III.
summary_es: Este ensayo de fase III evalúa agregar gemcitabina a la BCG administrada en la vejiga, en comparación con la BCG sola, en personas con cáncer de vejiga de alto grado no músculo invasivo que reapareció después de una terapia previa con BCG. La gemcitabina se administra en la vejiga durante 1 hora en las semanas 1, 4, 7 y 10, y la BCG se administra durante 2 horas en las semanas 2, 3, 6, 8 y 9, con repetición del tratamiento en los meses 3, 6 y 12 si no hay progresión de la enfermedad ni toxicidad inaceptable. El registro no indica la medida de resultado principal; el estudio es de fase III.
who_for: High grade bladder cancer limited to the lining (Ta, T1 or carcinoma in situ), confirmed within 120 days before randomization.
Recurrence within 24 months of prior BCG, without meeting the BCG-unresponsive definition.
Visible papillary tumors removed by TURBT within 90 days of randomization.
Prior BCG exposure is required; prior intravesical chemotherapy or other NMIBC treatments are allowed.
not_for: Any small cell or large cell neuroendocrine carcinoma component.
BCG-unresponsive bladder cancer, as defined in the record.
Past intolerance to BCG or other intravesical therapy.
Muscle-invasive, locally advanced unresectable, or metastatic urothelial carcinoma on recent imaging.
Pregnant or breastfeeding, or of childbearing potential without a pregnancy test within 14 days.
